description.en-US:
QuickNovel is an open-source Android application designed for downloading, organizing, and reading light novels and web novels directly on your device. Rather than hosting content, it utilizes a modular web scraping system to fetch stories from various online sources and convert them into readable formats or EPUB/PDF files.

Key features:

- Download novels for offline reading in EPUB or PDF formats
- Built-in customizable reader with text sizing, fonts, and night mode
- Integrated online translation support for foreign language sources
- Advanced search and filtering across multiple provider sources
- Built-in Text-To-Speech (TTS) integration for listening on the go
- Organized library management with bookmarks, history, and reading progress
- Completely ad-free and open-source experience
- Optimized interface for Android phones and tablets
